connector.name: Shiplight
connector.registryDescription: An MCP server that provides browser automation
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.shiplight, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: PWDEBUG
env.description: Must be set to "console". Enables Playwright semantic locator generation (getByRole, getByTestId) for action entities. Without it, only XPath locators are available.
